enable_heartflow.hint: 启用后，机器人将智能判断群聊消息并主动回复

judge_provider_name.hint: 用于小参数模型判断的提供商，建议使用响应较快、成本较低的模型

compress_persona.hint: llm 与 jev 两种模式共用。关闭时判断器拿人格全文；开启后使用下方「压缩人格提示词」，为空时用「判断模型提供商」自动压缩一次并写回，压缩失败的那次仍用全文

compressed_persona.hint: 判断用的精简人格。留空时开启压缩后的第一次判断会用「判断模型提供商」自动压缩一次并写回这里，之后固定使用这一份，可随时查看和修改；人格改了想重新生成就清空（或 /heartflow_cache_clear）。仅在开启「启用人格压缩」时使用

reply_threshold.hint: 超过此阈值才会主动回复，值越高越严格。judge_mode=llm 时比较的是五维加权综合分，judge_mode=jev 时比较的是 noul 概率

energy_decay_rate.hint: 每次回复后精力下降的幅度，影响后续回复的积极性

energy_recovery_rate.hint: 每次不回复时，以及每经过5分钟时恢复的精力幅度

context_messages_count.hint: 用于追踪上次回复和群聊活跃度的本地缓冲基数，实际缓冲区会保留更多消息

whitelist_enabled.hint: 启用后只有白名单中的群聊才会触发心流回复

chat_whitelist.hint: 允许心流回复的群聊sid列表，/sid获取

judge_relevance.description: 判断权重的内容相关度
judge_relevance.hint: 针对判断权重的内容相关度设置，默认25%

judge_willingness.hint: 针对判断权重的回复意愿设置，默认20%

judge_social.description: 判断权重的社交适宜性
judge_social.hint: 针对判断权重的社交适宜性设置，默认20%

judge_timing.description: 判断权重的时机相关性
judge_timing.hint: 针对判断权重的时机相关性设置，默认15%

judge_continuity.description: 判断权重的对话连贯性
judge_continuity.hint: 针对判断权重的对话连贯性设置，默认20%

judge_include_reasoning.hint: 让小模型在判断时返回简短理由。关闭可轻微提升性能和鲁棒性。

judge_max_retries.description: 判断失败最大重试次数
judge_max_retries.hint: 判断重试次数，设为0时不重试，建议1-5次。llm 模式重试的是无效JSON，jev 模式重试的是 429/529 限流

judge_timeout_seconds.hint: 整轮判断（包含格式重试）或单次人格总结的最长等待时间，超时后本条消息不会触发回复

judge_context_count.description: 传入判断模型的上下文条数
judge_context_count.hint: 实际传给判断模型的最近对话条数，建议5-20条

min_reply_interval_seconds.hint: 两次心流主动触发之间的最短间隔秒数，0表示不限制，可防止机器人过于频繁发言

debounce_seconds.hint: 0 表示关闭（每条消息都判断）。设为正数时，第一条新消息开一个窗口，窗口内到达的消息攒成一批，窗口结束后整批一起交给判断模型（current_messages 字段）。刷屏时把 N 次判断降成 1 次，模型看到的是完整一段对话而不是只看最后一条。窗口长度从开窗算起，不会被新消息续期

max_tracked_chats.hint: 限制内存中保留的群聊状态和消息缓冲数量，超出后淘汰最久未使用且未在处理中的群聊

judge_mode.hint: llm = 小参数模型判断（现状）；jev = TypeSafe Jev 判断引擎（结构化打分+置信度，需 API key）

jev_api_key.hint: TypeSafe 控制台获取；留空时读取环境变量 TYPESAFE_API_KEY

jev_model.hint: 锁定版本保证判断可复现；填 jev-latest 则跟随官方最新（别名会漂移）

jev_prompts.hint: judge_mode=jev 时发给 Jev 的六道判断题，建议用英文。题目键名固定只改内容；Score 题的五档标准必须正好 5 条。判断日志开 DEBUG 可看到完整请求体

instructions.default: You are deciding whether the bot should proactively speak in a group chat. current_messages holds the new messages since the bot last considered speaking, in order. Judge them together as one moment, not one by one. The bot's name and identity are given in the persona. Answer YES only when at least one of these new messages is directed at the bot: it calls the bot by name or nickname, asks the bot a question, responds to something the bot previously said, or explicitly invites the bot to join or invites another member to interact with the bot. Answer NO when the messages address a different name (another bot or another member), and NO when the bot is merely the topic of banter or commentary between members without anyone engaging the bot. Answer NO for everything else: conversations between other members, people thinking aloud, and emotional venting not addressed to the bot, even if joining in would feel natural. When in doubt, answer NO.

criteria_true.default: At least one new message speaks to the bot by name or nickname, continues the bot's own thread, or invites interaction with the bot

criteria_false.default: The new messages are all for someone else or another bot, or only talk about the bot without engaging it

relevance.description: 内容相关度 Score（仅观测）

instructions.default: current_messages holds the new messages since the bot last considered speaking, in order. Judge them together as one moment, not one by one. How relevant are they to the bot's persona, and does the persona have something genuine to contribute?

criteria.description: 五档标准（第 1 条 = 0 分，第 5 条 = 4 分）
default: Completely irrelevant: random chatter the persona has no stake in, or content it could not meaningfully respond to
Mostly irrelevant: generic small talk with nothing for the persona to hook onto
Somewhat relevant: the persona could respond, but would add little value
Clearly relevant: matches the persona's interests or expertise, and the persona has something real to contribute
Directly relevant: the message explicitly invites this persona's participation, e.g. asks the kind of question this persona would answer or touches its core interests

instructions.default: Setting aside the bot's energy level (which the application handles separately), how much would this persona want to join in on what the current_messages are about?

criteria.description: 五档标准（第 1 条 = 0 分，第 5 条 = 4 分）
default: No interest at all: the topic leaves the persona completely cold
Little interest: the persona would have nothing to say about this topic
Mild interest: the persona could take it or leave it
Interested: the persona would enjoy talking about this topic
Strong interest: the topic is exactly what this persona loves to talk about

social.description: 社交适宜性 Score（仅观测）

instructions.default: After the current_messages, how socially appropriate would a reply from the bot be? Messages clearly exchanged between other members must score low.

criteria.description: 五档标准（第 1 条 = 0 分，第 5 条 = 4 分）
default: Socially wrong: the message is part of a private exchange between other members, or an emotional moment the bot should not intrude on
Poor fit: a reply would interrupt the current flow between members
Neutral: a reply would be neither welcome nor intrusive
Good fit: the conversation is open and a bot reply would feel natural
Ideal: the group is waiting for someone to respond, or the message openly invites any member to chime in

instructions.default: Given minutes_since_last_reply, is the moment right after the current_messages a good time for the bot to speak again? Speaking too soon after the last reply is spammy.

criteria.description: 五档标准（第 1 条 = 0 分，第 5 条 = 4 分）
default: Terrible timing: the bot just spoke and speaking again now would be spammy
Too soon: the bot replied within the last few minutes
Acceptable: some time has passed since the bot's last reply
Good: it has been a while since the bot last spoke
Perfect: the bot has not replied for a long time, or has never replied in this chat

instructions.default: How strongly are the current_messages connected to the bot's last reply? When there is no previous bot reply, treat the connection as neutral (middle).

criteria.description: 五档标准（第 1 条 = 0 分，第 5 条 = 4 分）
default: Totally disconnected: a new topic with zero relation to anything the bot said; jumping in would feel random
Weak link: only a superficial connection to the bot's last reply
Neutral: no previous bot reply exists, or the connection is neither strong nor weak
Clear link: the message follows up on the bot's last reply or stays on the same topic
Direct continuation: the message explicitly responds to or quotes the bot's last reply
